description: Upsert prospects into HubSpot as contacts (keyed by email), with an optional lifecycle stage and a note. Two-phase: call without confirm to preview, show the preview to the user, then call again with confirm=true and the confirmation_token after explicit approval. If any approved contact changes before confirming, the confirm is rejected and you must preview again. Idempotent by email (re-syncing never duplicates). overwrite_existing:false (default) only fills empty HubSpot properties. Suppressed prospects are excluded unless include_suppressed. Honors OPENSDR_READ_ONLY. Demo mode returns simulated:true.
name: sdr_sync_hubspot
title: Sync to HubSpot
